administration.note: Packet sizes and assignment are operational engineering defaults, not claims about psychometric or sample-size adequacy. No engineering scoring model is assigned to the successor bank. The 0.11 research pool includes NEI122; the public Full route separately administers NEI014@1. The 0.12 research pool includes NEI123; the public Full route also administers the prior NEI122@1 criterion question. The 0.13 research pool includes AHI108@1; the public routes replace AHI104@1 in a separate versioned release. The 0.14 research pool includes EPI122@1; the public routes replace EPI021@1 in a separate versioned release. The 0.15 research pool includes NEI121@1; Full replaces NEI101@1 in a separately versioned public release.
